scope: N41 fig-160 and fig-161 source fidelity, construction, current SVG and actual complete 480/300 PNGs only

observations: Original pixels were loaded first and inventoried before reading any author inventory, spec or claims. One subfigure and all S,A,B,C,D,N,M labels survive.

Full 480x560 and 300x350 actual PNGs each viewed once. Solid SA/SB/SC continuations and AD/DB, dashed AB and SNM, and N's filled diamond survive with clear label separation; no clipping or missing construction.

Independent prose disambiguation gives gamma=ASB, beta=ASC=ASD, alpha=BSC=BSD. All three actual angle arcs have the correct respective projected endpoints. Their screen angles are not spatial measurements.
N is interior to AB and lies on SM; D is between S and C; M continues past N. The crossing of SM with DB is a projection crossing, not an added labelled spatial incidence.

Independent vector arithmetic confirms a non-flat spatial construction with SD=SN and angle ASD=ASN, hence the two SAS triangles; AD=AN, DB>NB, and the face ASB decomposes at SN. Reprojecting points and independently interpolated circular face arcs agrees with current spec coordinates/path samples.
No new numeric angle/length/answer labels, equality ticks, right-angle boxes, Cyrillic/Chinese/cultural imagery, or visible nonsemantic color content. Latin point names and mathematical symbols only.
Existing hash-current render PASS reused, not rerun: minimum rendered text 28px at480 and17.5px at300, above16px. Actual mobile-size labels remain readable.

Original pixels were inventoried before author claims: one subfigure, A1,S,A,B,C; opposite A1-S-A rays, solid SB/SC, dashed AB, curved solid AC/BC truncation boundaries, three face angles and two complementary face angles.

Full 480x600 and300x375 actual PNGs each viewed once. All ten labels, A1 subscript, three lower face arcs, both complementary expressions/leaders and gamma's dashed leader are present, legible and unclipped.
A1=-0.55*A relative to S independently confirms opposite rays, not collinearity alone. Nonzero determinant confirms genuine trihedral geometry.

Independent vector angles confirm A1SB+ASB=180 degrees and A1SC+ASC=180 degrees; alpha stays BSC. All five arc endpoint assignments and projected circular samples agree with the current SVG/spec geometry.

Curved AC/BC boundaries remain non-metric truncation outlines, not invented straight chords. No right-angle/equality symbols or answer values are introduced. The two 180-degree complement expressions are already source printed.
No cultural leakage, label collision, missing arc, cropped boundary, or broken/black raster. Existing hash-current renderer PASS is reused only: min text28px at480 and17.5px at300, both above16px.

independentRelationships.method: One read-only node -e vector calculation, not the author renderer/validator/checker. Dot products, norms, determinant, affine incidence, matrix reprojection, and sine-interpolated spatial circular arcs were calculated independently from the declared spatial witness; compared to current spec points and actual path numbers.
independentRelationships.meaning: Spatial witness and projected paths were independently checked against source/prose requirements. Rendered byte equality alone was not treated as source-fidelity evidence. Internal witness values are not learner-facing numerical answers.
